card.heard: Tokens arrive 50 times a second, how to update the UI without lag
card.say: I wouldn't update the UI on every token. The repository writes the pieces into the database, and the UI reads from there. So I'd batch the writes and the reads. card.say: I wouldn't write to Room 50 times a second. I'd collect tokens in the repository and flush them in small batches, maybe every 50 to 100 milliseconds.
